findings: The YAML selectors bone:pes_foot_l/r do not exist in this proxy skeleton; they are explicitly aliased to toe_rear_L/R.
The actual foot pads are 8-vertex boxes embedded in body_proxy; measuring toe bone tails under-reports pad-to-ground gap by about 0.035 m.
The remaining lowest body point is the rear tail at z=0.469616 m while rear pad bottoms are z=0.652438 m; translating the full asset down to ground the pads would put the tail below the plane.
An in-place cycle cannot establish planted world-space feet without actor stride translation and foot IK.
blockers: Foot-pad stance contact remains 0.646-0.665 m above the declared z=0 plane and horizontal stance slip reaches 0.104 m. Follow-up requires foot IK/stride handling and tail clearance review.
assumptions_made: Mapped the authored left/right pes selectors to hind toe bones because no matching pes_foot_l/r bones exist.
Used generated foot-pad bottom vertices, not toe-bone endpoints, as the contact surface.
Measured against the current z=0 scene plane; did not translate the model to conceal contact failure.
The 2.0 second cycle repeats at the runtime consumer; start/end keys are equal and the GLB animation contains one clip.
